mapper.insert: INSERT INTO meta_embedding (source_type, source_id, content_text, embedding, model_version, updated_at) VALUES ( #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{contentText}, #{embedding, typeHandler=com.text2report.domain.vector.typehandler.PgVectorTypeHandler}, #{modelVersion}, NOW() ) ON CONFLICT (source_type, source_id) DO UPDATE SET content_text = EXCLUDED.content_text, embedding = EXCLUDED.embedding, model_version = EXCLUDED.model_version, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT source_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM meta_embedding GROUP BY source_type
